search.note: Location in this admin search is the country string 'United States', not a patient city. The 300-mile / Ohio filter is applied on the pulled records, not by filter.geo.

region.rule: A trial is in the region if it has at least one United States site in Ohio, or with a geoPoint within 300 miles of Columbus, OH (39.9612, -82.9988). Distance is a haversine in statute miles. Sites with no geoPoint are included only when the state is Ohio.

modifications: Restricted the field list to the FIELDS array in scripts/ctgov-pull.mjs (not the full study record).
Dropped trials with no regional site.
Kept only regional sites on each slim record, with a computed milesFromColumbus field.
Added heuristic stage flags from title, summary, conditions and eligibility text. These flags are not official ClinicalTrials.gov fields.
